Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization (2501.03262v9) · paper method: REINFORCE++ replaces prompt-local advantage normalization with global normalization and describes a single-response configuration for general RLHF.

cohort8.claim.reinforce.global-normalization

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Single-response mode means one sampled response per prompt. Selected v9 also evaluates plain REINFORCE++ with k > 1 for reasoning (section 4.2). The baseline variant adds group-mean reshaping and is particularly advised for sample filtering and complex tasks such as multi-turn tool use (sections 3.2 and 5.1); multiple responses alone do not require it.

REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization (2501.03262v9) · paper method: The best-practice discussion distinguishes baseline variants that support binary 0/1 or symmetric −1/1 rewards from plain REINFORCE++, which the authors recommend with symmetric rewards.
